title: TenantWideEvidenceIntegrityFailedPayload
description: Payload of the TenantWideEvidenceIntegrityFailed platform event (class: platform; INV-REQ-662 b3, INV-Q-12994 option A). evidence-svc emits it for a tenant-wide chain; the shape equals that of EvidenceIntegrityFailedPayload. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

failingRecord.description: The record that failed the integrity check.
